human_cases.requirement: Typography follows the supplied brand type guidance.
human_cases.pass_condition: SentinelMesh / Website feature panel (website-feature.png): Typography follows the supplied brand type guidance.
human_cases.evidence_reference: A single humanist sans family across headings and body, set with generous spacing and modest weight contrast. No display faces, no condensed heads. Numerals and interface labels stay legible at the size a buyer actually reads them.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when text is present. A style-only brand guide requires expert judgement; no exact font name is invented.

human_cases.requirement: Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.pass_condition: SentinelMesh / Website feature panel (website-feature.png): Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.evidence_reference: Our designer built the original identity and left the company, and that working file left with him. What survives is a flat export of the mark on white and a phone photo of our trade show banner, neither of which is the source artwork. The mark needs to be rebuilt as usable artwork that sits correctly on our dark navy ground.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when a logo is required or used. Recovery briefs permit reconstruction; do not impose a false locked-logo rule.
